entities.name: Bat
entities.description: A creature type for nocturnal flying mammals, originally fearsome and dangerous in Magic and mostly black-aligned.

entities.name: Batfolk
entities.description: Bloomburrow animalfolk known for clerics and astronomers who read the stars; protective, hierarchical guardians of the Valley's night.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: A batfolk who assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Led a quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The bat god of Ixalan, enemy of the sun god and ruler of the night.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Infamous vampire lord of the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha, accompanied by Sengir Bats.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild primarily associated with bats used as assassins and messengers.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose hunters use giant bats as mounts.

entities.name: Lunar Paean
entities.description: Celebration batfolk host at the end of each of the four moon phases.

entities.name: Lighttrap Spires
entities.description: Batfolk site with a massive opaline gem where an elder batfolk trades sight for vision of other realms.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Beasts Mabel set out to stop.

events.summary: Batfolk across the Valley host the Lunar Paean at the end of each moon phase, assigning star charts to newborns and stars to the deceased.
events.quote: At the end of each of the four moon phases, batfolk across Valley host a celebration known as a Lunar Paean.

events.summary: An elder batfolk at the Lighttrap Spires trades their sight for vision of the realms beyond, marking their ascension to the priesthood's upper ranks.
events.quote: There, an elder batfolk trades their sight for vision of the realms beyond Valley.

events.summary: Zoraline assists Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: One of their kin, Zoraline , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts .

relations.quote: One of their kin, Zoraline , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts .
